thread:
emma-cs: FYI Foxbridge pilot goes live at 14:00 UTC today, requesting a short burst + APAC routing.
emma-cs: They want traffic routed to ap-southeast and an IP allow rule for their gateway.
tony-ops: got it — what's the window and target qps? :thinking_face:
emma-cs: 2h canary, target steady 250rps, spike to 600rps for a 10m stress test, then back to 250.
nora-se: renewal note: they're on the trial tier, usage spike will increase projected bill. flagged for AE to review renewals page. :warning:
emma-cs: also need an explicit allowlist for their NAT 34.82.10.7/32 and a region pin to ap-southeast-1 so latency is under 120ms.
tony-ops: infra-bot, can you stage a temporary route + allowlist with auto-revoke? tag: foxbridge-canary-172555
infra-bot: Received request. Preparing change: route=ap-southeast-1, ip_allow=34.82.10.7/32, rl_increase=250->600 (burst), revoke=172555+2h
tony-ops: snippet I'll apply in the control plane:

```
routes.apply(
  team="foxbridge",
  region="ap-southeast-1",
  allowlist=["34.82.10.7/32"],
  rate_window={"steady":250, "burst":600, "burst_window":600},
  autorevoke="2h"
)
```

emma-cs: please add a 15min warmup so we don't cold-start GPU pools.
tony-ops: acknowledged, will schedule warmup at 13:45 UTC and set a canary tag. :white_check_mark:
nora-se: AE @maria-accounts notified to monitor invoice delta and discuss renewal risk if usage persists.
emma-cs: customer asked for a post-run summary and cost estimate — tagging finance later.
tony-ops: change queued, executing at 13:45 UTC. I'll post back on completion and attach request id.
infra-bot: Change executed: req_id=chg-2024-FOX-789, active at 13:47 UTC, auto-revoke at 15:47 UTC. Monitoring logs for errors.
emma-cs: perfect — thanks team. I'll DM Foxbridge with the run plan and expected metrics. :rocket:
